description: Skyline as a mod: one tool.call hook on Read. A Read of a text file inside a code tree (a .git or .skyrift-workspace marker above it, not under ~/.claude, not a pdf/image/notebook or a pages request) is answered from the skyline daemon over $.http.fetch (MCP streamable HTTP, one initialize per session, re-initialised once after a daemon restart, marked down for 5 s after a transport failure): skyline's read with full:true and max_match_chars:0 is translated into the record core produces ({ type, file: { filePath, content, numLines, startLine, totalLines } }) and returned with skyline's ¶path#TAG anchor as one context line, so core's Read and the classic enforce hook beneath never run. Anything else, and any failure, goes on to core via next(e). Every result's shape is still recorded (stage 1): keys and types, text length, never file contents; each new shape announced once in the transcript, every record to the debug log, optionally a JSON shape file.
